note: Official certification objectives, recorded so every lesson can be traced to a real exam objective. Dates are the day each was checked against the publisher's own material. Anything not confirmed against a primary source is marked verified:false and must not be quoted as an exam fact.

exams.title: MikroTik Certified Network Associate

exams.sourceNote: Red Hat's own EX200 objectives page, read 2026-10-10. The page states explicitly: 'This exam is based on Red Hat Enterprise Linux 10.' CORRECTION: this exam is EX200, not EX294 — EX294 is the RHCE/Ansible exam. The exam is 100% hands-on: no multiple-choice questions, no internet access, no permitted documentation. Configurations must persist after a reboot without intervention, which is why so many objectives say 'configure to start automatically at boot'.

exams.title: Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Administrator Associate
exams.code: AZ-800 — formerly 'Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate'; the certification was renamed but the Learn URL slug is still windows-server-hybrid-administrator
exams.sourceNote: Microsoft Learn certification page, 'Assessed on this exam' section, read 2026-10-10. Page last updated 2026-01-21. Per-domain percentage weights are rendered dynamically by JavaScript and were NOT extractable from the page source, so only the assessed areas are recorded here — no weights are claimed.
exams.coverageCaveat: AZ-800 is substantially a HYBRID and AZURE exam. The named products on the exam include Azure Arc, Azure Policy, Azure Monitor, Azure Automation, Azure Files, Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Cloud and Azure IaaS virtual machines. Domains 2, 3, 7, 8 and 9 are largely about Azure. This manual is deliberately ON-PREMISES focused and covers NONE of the Azure-specific material — it maps to domains 1, 4, 5, 6 and 10 only. Treat the Azure half of AZ-800 as a real gap this manual does not address.
